row.evidence: StreamYard's help centre says SSO (SAML/OIDC via WorkOS) is a paid add-on on the Business plan, and that StreamYard does not currently have a public API; no SCIM or provisioning documentation exists on its pricing page or help centre.
row.notes: Status changed unknown -> none (absence): help-centre search for 'scim', 'provisioning', 'okta', 'onelogin', 'directory' and 'deactivate' returns no provisioning article; SSO article documents only SAML/OIDC via WorkOS. Team plan changed from Core to Business because the pricing page says Core and Advanced are for individual use only (Core $35.99/mo, Advanced $68.99/mo, annual). Business is $249/mo billed yearly with 2 seats included (up to 1000); Enterprise is Contact us with 5+ seats and lists SSO. Help centre says SSO is a paid add-on on Business (price via support), which conflicts with the pricing page placing SSO under Enterprise. The June claim of a OneLogin provisioning connector has no first-party source (OneLogin connector page blocked) and was dropped. Old Business $249 price unchanged.

plans.name: Business
plans.price_text: $249/mo billed yearly ($299 monthly), 2 seats included, up to 1000
plans.notes: SSO is a paid add-on requested through support per the help centre; extra seat price shown only in-account.

limitations.text: Members are invited and removed manually in the Members tab; adding requires a free seat.

entra.notes: No Entra Learn tutorial at the expected URL (404).

onelogin.notes: OneLogin connector page returned a bot challenge (HTTP 202, empty); June's provisioning claim not verifiable.

fallbacks.notes: SSO via WorkOS supports SAML and OIDC, SP-initiated only; docs do not say whether first SSO sign-in creates accounts.
